title: Flat single tensorator through homotopy single complexes
statement: Let B be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, X a scheme, and L,M B-valued etale sheaves on X with L flat. Write s for degree-zero cochain inclusion, q for the homotopy quotient, e(A)=singleFunctorObjIsoQh(A), and t(L,M)=singleCochainTensorIso(L,M). Then singleFunctorObjTensorIso(L,M).hom = (e(L).hom tensor e(M).hom);μQh(q(sL),q(sM));Qh(q(t(L,M).hom));e(L tensor M).inv. The notions are [def-kun-derived-tensor], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and [lem-pur-etale-single-cochain-monoidal].

source.place: Tags 06YQ and 06YU; explicit expansion of the composite-functor tensorator in lem-pur-etale-single-tensorator-factorization.

proof.text: Apply singleFunctorObjTensorIso_factorization. Expand the lax tensorator of the composite q followed by Qh. The tensorator of q is an identity, so Qh maps it to an identity; cancel it. The two remaining maps are exactly the Qh tensorator and Qh of q of the cochain tensorator. Keep the initial tensor of the prescribed e maps and its final inverse unchanged.

theorem singleFunctorObjTensorIso_homotopy_factorization
    (L M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (hL : ObjectProperty.flat L) :
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ)
    let s := HomologicalComplex.single (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ) 0
    (singleFunctorObjTensorIso L M hL).hom =
      ((singleFunctorObjIsoQh L).hom ⊗ₘ (singleFunctorObjIsoQh M).hom) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh (q.obj (s.obj L)) (q.obj (s.obj M)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map (q.map (singleCochainTensorIso L M).hom) ≫
        (singleFunctorObjIsoQh (L ⊗ M)).inv
